note: Suwannee County publishes its zoning only as a 2008 static PDF atlas; Live Oak publishes its zoning only as a 12-05-2023 PDF atlas. The county GIS parcel layer (Parcels_Suwannee_2024) has a ZONING field but it is empty for all 31,761 parcels, so no queryable zoning polygons exist. Branford: no zoning service found. The county planning page says GIS layers are available only on request, with no public endpoint.
